title: Adversarial tester
brief: Your job is to break it. Read each candidate looking for the input its author did not think of: empty, single-element, unsorted, duplicated, adjacent, negative, very large. For each weakness, name the exact input and the output you expect to be wrong. A suspicion without a concrete input is not an objection.
notes: An adversarial role proposes tests. A proposed failing input is an allegation until it is run.
